senses.gloss:
शुल्क् शुल्क्, cl. 10. P. शुल्कयति, -यितुम्,
to pay, give; to gain, acquire; to
abandon, leave, forsake; to create (सर्जने); to
narrate, tell; [cf. rt. श्वल्क्.]

शुल्क, अस्, अम्, m. n. toll, tax, duty, customs
(especially money levied at ferries, passes, and roads);
a sum of money, price, (Sāy. = मूल्य); property,
wealth, (Sāy. = धन); gain, profit; money ad-
vanced to ratify a bargain; money given to the
parents of the bride (originally as purchase-price); a
present made by a bridegroom to his bride; nuptial
present; a marriage-settlement or dower; a wife's
perquisites or private property (such as the profits of
household labour, domestic utensils, milch cattle,
ornaments, servants, &c.).
—शुल्क-खण्डन, अम्,
n. defrauding the revenue.
—शुल्क-ग्राहक, अस्,
इका, अम्, or शुल्क-ग्राहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, receiving a
toll or duty.
—शुल्क-द, अस्, m. the giver of a
nuptial present, an affianced suitor.
—शुल्क-मो-
षण, अम्, n. stealing or defrauding the revenue.
—शुल्क-शाला, f. a custom-house; [cf. शौल्क-
शालिक.]
—शुल्क-सञ्ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, having (merely)
the name of a nuptial gratuity.
—शुल्क-स्थान, अम्,
n. a toll-office, custom-house (Manu VIII. 400);
any object of taxation or duty.
—शुल्क-हानि, इस्,
f. loss or forfeiture of wages or dower, &c.
—शुल्का-
भिधान (˚क-अभ्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, = शुल्क-सञ्ज्ञ.
—शुल्कावाप्त (˚क-अव्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, obtained as a
dowry.

शुल्किक शुल्किक, अस्, m., N. of a country
or district; [cf. शौल्किकेय.]

शुल्ल शुल्ल, अम्, n. (for शुल्व), a cord, rope,
string; copper (= ताम्र; cf. शुल्व).

शूल, अस्, अम्, m. n. any sharp or acute pain;
pain in the stomach, colic; rheumatism, gout; any
sharp or pointed weapon, a pike, dart, spear, lance,
spike; the trident of Śiva; a sharp iron pin or spit
(on which meat is roasted); a stake for impaling
criminals; a banner, ensign; the ninth astronomical
Yoga; death, dying; (आ), f. a stake for impaling
criminals; a harlot, prostitute; [cf. Slav. sūliza.]
—शूल-गव, a kind of animal sacrifice.
—शूल-
ग्रन्थि, इस्, f. ‘having sharp knots,’ a kind of Dūrvā
grass (= माला-दूर्वा).
—शूल-घातन, अम्, n.
‘pain-destroying,’ iron rust or filings.
—शूल-घ्न,
अस्, ई, अम्, removing or allaying sharp pain, sedative,
anodyne; (अस्), m. a kind of plant (= तुम्बुरु).
—शूल-द्विष्, ट्, m. ‘enemy to colic,’ Asa Fetida.
—शूल-धन्वन्, आ, m. ‘having a trident for a
bow,’ epithet of Śiva.
—शूल-धर, अस्, m. ‘spear-
holder, trident-holder,’ epithet of Śiva; (आ), f.
epithet of Durgā.
—शूल-धारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, spear-
holding, lance-bearing, trident-holding; (इणी), f.
epithet of Durgā.
—शूल-धृक्, m. (see धृक्,
p. 459), ‘trident-bearing,’ epithet of Śiva; (क्), f.
epithet of Durgā.
—शूल-नाशन, अम्, n. ‘remov-
ing pain in the stomach,’ white sochal salt.
—शूल-
पत्त्री, f. a kind of grass (= शूली).
—शूल-पाणि,
इस्, m. ‘trident-handed,’ epithet of Śiva (regarded
as the king of the Bhūtas); N. of the author of the
Prāyaścitta-viveka and of the Tithi-dvaidha-prakaraṇa
and of the Yājñavalkya-ṭīkā.
—शूल-पाणिन्, ई, इनी,
इ, holding or bearing a lance or spear.
—शूल-भृत्,
त्, m. ‘spear-holder,’ an epithet of Śiva.
—शूल-
भेद, अस्, m., N. of a place.
—शूल-मुद्गर-
हस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, having a lance and mace in hand,
armed with a lance and club.
—शूल-वेदना, f.
sharp or acute pain.
—शूल-शत्रु, उस्, m. ‘hostile
to colic,’ the castor-oil plant, Ricinus Communis.
—शूल-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, fixed on a stake, impaled.
—शूल-हन्त्री, f. ‘colic-removing,’ a kind of barley
(= यवानी).
—शूल-हस्त, अस्, m. ‘lance-handed,’
a man armed with a lance, lancer, pikeman.
—शूल-
हृत्, त्, m. ‘removing colic,’ Asa Fetida.
—शूला-
कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to roast on a spit.
—शूलाकृत (˚ल-आक्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, roasted on a
spit, &c.; (अम्), n. roasted meat.
—शूलाग्र (˚ल-
अग्˚), अम्, n. the point of a pike or stake, &c.
—शूलेश्वरी-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.
—शू-
लोत्खा (˚ल-उत्˚), f. the medicinal plant Serratula
Anthelmintica.
—शूलोद्यत-कर (˚ल-उद्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, with uplifted spear in hand.

शुल्व् शुल्व् (also written शुल्ब्), cl. 10. P.
शुल्वयति, -यितुम्, to send away, dis-
miss; to measure; to create.

शुल्व or शुल्ब, अम्, n. (according to Uṇādi-s.
IV. 95. fr. rt. 1. शुच्), a rope, cord, string, (said to
be also अस्, m., आ or ई, f.); copper, a copper vessel;
a sacrificial observance; institute, law, custom; a
quantity of water; (आनि), n. pl., N. of a Pariśiṣṭa
of the Yajur-veda; [cf. शुल्विक.]
—शुल्व-ज, अम्,
n. brass.
—शुल्व-दीपिका, f., N. of a work.
—शुल्व-
परिशिष्ट and शुल्व-वार्त्तिक and शुल्व-सूत्र,
अम्, n., N. of works.
—शुल्वारि (˚व-अरि), इस्, m.
‘enemy of copper,’ sulphur.

शुल्विक, आनि, n. pl., N. of a Pariśiṣṭa of the
Yajur-veda.

शूल् शूल् (rather a Nom. fr. शूल below),
cl. 1. P. शूलति, शुशूल, शूलितुम्, to be
ill; to disorder, make sick, disease; to pierce, transfix,
impale; to cry, make a loud noise; to collect (?).

शूलक, अस्, m. a restive or unbroken horse;
[cf. शूकल.]

शूलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, suffering sharp pain, suffering
from colic; armed with a spear or pike, carrying a
lance or stake; (ई), m. a spearman, pikeman, lancer;
epithet of Śiva (as holding a trident); a hare; N.
of a Muni; (इनी), f. epithet of Durgā.
शूलिन, अस्, m. the Indian fig-tree (= भाण्डीर).
शूली, f. a kind of grass (= मधु-लता).

शूल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, roasted on a spit; deserving
impalement; (अम्), n. roasted meat.
—शूल्य-पाक,
अस्, m. any meat or other substance roasted on a spit.
—शूल्य-मांस, अम्, n. roast meat, meat cooked
on a spit.

सुल्लण सुल्लण, अस्, m., N. of a commen-
tator.
सुल्हण सुल्हण, अस्, m., N. of a poet.
